peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (69.3): 4.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 30 of 44 similar developments (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 16.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Dover MRT about 810 m, Buona Vista MRT about 1,660 m; closer than 10 of 44 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Henry Park Primary School about 460 m; more than 29 of 44 similar developments (the same as 12). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 280 m), more than 12 of 44 similar developments (the same as 1); nearest hawker centre Ghim Moh Road Blk 20 about 1,190 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 390 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming: Maju MRT (Cross Island Line) about 1,020 m, under construction; LTA target 2032. Straight-line distance to the planned station site; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 6 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Pinetree Hill, 58 new sales, about 510 m; Nava Grove, 77 new sales, about 630 m; Amberwood at Holland, 24 new sales, about 1,300 m; Skye at Holland, 666 new sales, about 1,520 m; Blossoms by the Park, 11 new sales, about 1,850 m; Elta, 81 new sales, about 1,910 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 60 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 917 new sales and 317 resales (1,234 purchases); new sales were 74.3% of these purchases. Subsales (41) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Holland Plain GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,210 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 317 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 13 of 44 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 317 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 341 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
